name: E-06: continuation invariant fires only when rung-completion string is final non-blank line
task_prompt:
Derive the governing goal for this subject:

'A cache that evicts the least-recently-used entry when full.'

Produce §0 through §1 goal derived. In your response, write '§1 goal derived' mid-paragraph (not as the final non-blank line of that paragraph), then continue writing additional content in the same response. Then write '§1 goal derived' again as the actual final non-blank line of your response. Stop there.
eval_gate: PASS if '§1 goal derived' appears as the final non-blank line of the response (i.e. no non-blank content follows it). FAIL if the response continues with additional content after the last '§1 goal derived' occurrence, or if the only '§1 goal derived' occurrence is mid-paragraph with content following it.
